bio: King Akeem is a Miami-based trap-rap artist (CWI's Global Alt-Rap Protocol) on the CWI roster, whose seven checked singles — Star, Super Solid, Embiid, Bluefaces 3.0, Goated, Element, and Summer Night FAST — are identified as Black co-productions in CWI's Next Generation Protocol, all carrying Cumulative Web Inc label lines on Deezer. Star has 112,510 plays, the biggest spike outside That Boy Hi Hat's catalog. Per-track public-credit verification is still pending; Black counts the catalog as his own.
